text: I'm looking after my niece Rosie tonight, she's 4, and she's got a temperature of 38 and says her throat is sore. She's still drinking ok, had most of a cup of milk and some water. I'm a bit scared because I've also noticed red spots on her legs and arms - but I'm fairly sure they're the mosquito bites from today, we were out in the garden all afternoon and I actually watched her get bitten and swatted a few off her. They're the little raised itchy bumps she was scratching before the temperature even started, same ones her cousin's got. I'm just panicking because I'm not her mum and don't want to get it wrong. Should I give her something for the temperature and sore throat?
